name: Idle Thoughts: Glimpse 4 (look at the top four cards, put back in any order)
notes: Shared between the Kongming and Jin Starter Decks. Glimpse() (GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GameLogic.php:15040) queues an MZREARRANGE decision with the exact param format 'Top=<cardIDs>;Bottom=<cardIDs>' -- the response is that same string submitted verbatim (same no-op default GoldfishChooseAction uses for MZREARRANGE, GameLogic.php:254-255), which keeps the glimpsed cards on top in their original order. The specific card IDs in the response are deck-shuffle-dependent, so they were confirmed via a direct probe against this exact deck/seed before being hardcoded into the action. Deck count is unaffected (glimpse only looks/reorders, no cards leave the deck); Idle Thoughts itself resolves to the graveyard as a normal Action card.

rulesClauses: Look at the top four cards of your deck and then put them back in any order.
